scope: Anonymously visible submitted records; each included field and inventory returned successfully with loggedIn:false. Private export used only for submitted ID eligibility.

verification.sourceLink: Original portal requires its in-page Search/openSubmission controls; no submission deep-link URL verified.

postCaptureEnvelopeAudit.note: Representative fresh responses for every used route conform. The additional explicit success:false/nonobject guard was added after this capture started; historic per-request flags were not retained.

limitations: Rich HTML is sanitized; inline media bytes are replaced with source references and SHA-256 digests, not remote URLs.
Existing remote media URLs are references only; their bodies are not fetched.
Attachment/spatial-file bodies and monitoring observations are excluded.
submittedBy and parentId are included only when returned anonymously; assignedTo, private drafts, permissions and administrative catalogue text are excluded.
Current form definitions describe captured values; this is not an atomic historical database snapshot.
